blocks.orig:
Mafia Island is a perfect escape from the fast pace and busy daily life. This island is still pure and untouched, which means there are no tarmac roads and only few tourists. It’s like Zanzibar a few decades ago. The atmosphere is peaceful and the islanders are very friendly.
Mafia is part of the Zanzibar Archipelago and surrounded by some of the richest coral reefs in the world. Almost half of Mafia’s coastline is part of the Mafia Island Marine Park, a park full of coral reefs, mangrove forests and lagoons. This is the largest protected area in the Indian Ocean. The barrier reef is a dream to divers and snorkelers. It has 50 different corals and more than 460 species of fish! Mafia’s incredible and pure dive spots have remained a well-kept secret. Mangrove forests surround most of the island, therefore the deserted beaches are not as wide as the ones in Zanzibar, yet still beautiful. The dazzling marine life is the main feature of the island.  This is the place to spot humpback whales, turtles and the biggest fish on earth – the whale shark. Thus, Mafia Island is a unique place for travellers and honeymooners to unwind after their Tanzania Safari.
blocks.html:
If you want to get away from the hustle and rush of everyday life, Mafia Island is ideal. The island remains pure and untouched: there are no tarmac roads and tourists are few. Think of Zanzibar as it was a few decades ago. The mood is peaceful and the islanders are very welcoming.
Mafia belongs to the Zanzibar Archipelago and is ringed by some of the richest coral reefs on the planet. Nearly half of Mafia’s coastline falls within the Mafia Island Marine Park, which is full of coral reefs, mangrove forests and lagoons and is the largest protected area in the Indian Ocean. For divers and snorkelers, the barrier reef is a dream come true, with 50 different corals and over 460 fish species! Mafia’s remarkable, unspoilt dive sites are still a well-kept secret. As mangrove forests line most of the island, the deserted beaches are narrower than those of Zanzibar, but no less beautiful. The island’s main attraction is its dazzling marine life. Humpback whales, turtles and the largest fish on earth – the whale shark – can all be spotted here. That makes Mafia Island a special place for travellers and honeymooners to relax after their Tanzania Safari.

blocks.orig: In Mafia Island, just like in Zanzibar and Pemba, there are several accommodations to choose from. For your convenience, we offer you our personal favourite lodges within our three categories. For Silver, this is the Mafia Kivulini Lodge. A beautiful and rustic lodge at an affordable rate, offering all the amenities any dream beach vacation would need. The lodge boasts clean and tasteful decorated rooms with verandas, overlooking a beautiful garden with palm- and coconut trees.
blocks.html: As on Zanzibar and Pemba, Mafia Island has a range of accommodation to pick from. To make it easy for you, we have selected our personal favourite lodges in each of our three categories. In Silver, that is the Mafia Kivulini Lodge: a lovely, rustic lodge at an affordable price with every amenity a dream beach holiday calls for. Its rooms are clean and tastefully decorated, each with a veranda looking out over a beautiful garden of palm and coconut trees.

blocks.orig: For Gold and for Platinum, we recommend Pole Pole Bungalows, an exclusive and unique eco-lodge. It uses a state-of-the-art purification system to treat waste water to prevent environmental pollution. Furthermore, the bungalows and suites each have their own unique features, depending on the type of luxury you desire. Each room and suite has its own ensuite bathroom, antique décor and private veranda overlooking a gorgeous scenery. And if you choose to go Platinum, you get to take a dip in your own plunge pool built in your veranda, overlooking your own beach front!
blocks.html: In Gold and Platinum, our recommendation is Pole Pole Bungalows, an exclusive, one-of-a-kind eco-lodge. Waste water is treated with a state-of-the-art purification system so that the environment stays unpolluted. The bungalows and suites each have their own distinctive features, matched to the level of luxury you are after. Every room and suite comes with an ensuite bathroom, antique décor and a private veranda with gorgeous views. Choose Platinum and you can cool off in your own plunge pool, set into your veranda and facing your own stretch of beach!
